[[Moss Spider (pre-Searing)|Moss Spiders]] could be found in Ascalon before [[the Searing]]. When they grow in their natural environment they can't be charmed to be used as [[animal companion]]s. So in order to charm one, the player must acquire an [[Moss Spider Egg|egg]], and hand it over to [[Emryd the Tamer]] to care for in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]]. Wild Moss Spiders are considered to be extinct now.

== Locations == 
* [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
** {{NPC location|Green Hills County}}
** {{NPC location|Regent Valley (pre-Searing)}}

== Notes ==
* Found as hostile in [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)]] and neutral in [[Green Hills County]].
* Unlike other wildlife in pre-Searing, they have a profession displayed in their [[User interface#Target display|target display]] when [[target]]ed.
*Moss spiders use melee attacks.

==Trivia==
*[[Shadow]]'s pet [[Carlotta]] is a Moss Spider.
